description: While parsing, comments are extracted as trivia separately from the program's statements. Each extracted comment records its kind: a single-line comment introduced by a double-slash, or a block comment delimited by slash-star and star-slash. A block comment embedded inside an otherwise valid construct is still extracted as one comment and does not affect the surrounding statement. The parser reports the total number of comments and, for each, its kind in source order. Type-annotation syntax is enabled for these inputs.
